data.text: **Question:** A production API is suddenly responding slowly. How do you troubleshoot?
Start with monitoring: check CPU, memory, database connections. Review recent changes. Use profiling tools. Check for deadlocks, long-running queries, or memory leaks.
Systematic approach: 1) Check monitoring dashboards 2) Review recent deployments 3) Check database performance 4) Profile the application 5) Check for resource exhaustion 6) Review logs
